title: How Chinese Characters Began as Pictures
thesis: 山 is three peaks. 人 is a pair of walking legs. 从 is one of them standing behind another.

musicPrompt: Sparse solo piano with felt hammers, unhurried, wide space between notes. Soft upright bass notes far back. Warm room tone, faint brushed cymbal texture. Contemplative study-room mood, gentle and curious, never sentimental. Instrumental only, no vocals, no strong melodic hook that competes with a speaking voice.

youtube.title: Chinese characters are drawings. Here are eight of them.
youtube.description:
山 is three peaks with the middle one tallest. 水 is a current with droplets thrown off either side. 人 is a person mid-stride — and put one person behind another and you get 从, to follow.

None of it is arbitrary. It is drawings, stacked and simplified, for three thousand years.

Not Arbitrary: things that look like meaningless convention, shown to be pictures.

tiktok.caption: 人 is a walking person. Put one behind another and you get 从 — to follow. Chinese characters are drawings.
